dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.renewalMailSubject: Your prepaid hours are running low
dashboard.renewalMailBody:
Hi {{client}}

I can see that your prepaid package "{{name}}" only has {{remaining}} hours left. To avoid any interruptions, I suggest we renew it with a new batch of hours.

Just let me know if that sounds good and I'll send over a new agreement.

Best regards
